EmailTemplate.subject: ITA L2 - CO - New Pay Type
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
We understand that you are interested in adding a new pay type to your Time & Attendance system. In order to determine the extent of this change, and ensure proper setup, we have a few questions:
Is this an hours, dollars, or units pay type?
If units, what will be the rate per unit?
Will the per-unit rate differ based upon employee/pay group?
Is this pay type going to be sent to payroll?
If so, has there already been a pay code designated in your payroll system for this addition?
Will this pay type count towards overtime, deduct from an accrual plan, and/or deduct from a salary record?
Should this pay type be available to all employees?
Will this pay type be added directly to employee timecards, or will it be requested by employees/generated automatically based upon a data condition, such as working between 10 PM and 2 AM?
Will this pay type need to be allocated across different departments/locations/cost centers?
Should this pay code be visible on:
The Request Module?
The Time Off Calendar?
The Approvals Page?
Thank you in advance for providing this information. Once it is received, a member of our team will determine the next steps and a representative will be in touch as soon as they are able.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
